test_downcast_polymorphic_animals: test the pybind11 tagbased polymorphic downcast by creating a zoo and verifying animal types and behaviors
create_zoo_with_polymorphic_animals: create a zoo of polymorphic animals including Labrador, Dog, Chihuahua, Cat, and Panther using the tagbased_polymorphic module
test_animal_bark_method: test the bark method on dog-type animals in the polymorphic zoo to verify correct sound output per subclass
test_animal_purr_method: test the purr method on cat-type animals in the polymorphic zoo to verify correct sound output per subclass
test_animal_properties: test animal properties like name, sound, and excitement on polymorphic objects returned by create_zoo
